longform.headline: Paris rebuilt the week online
longform.opening: In 2020, the official calendar acquired a digital twin.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: FHCM states that Paris Fashion Week Online launched in 2020 with Launchmetrics and support from LE DEFI; official calendars now have physical and digital dimensions.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: The digital platform expanded official collection visibility, but a public stream does not establish open admission, neutral ranking or permanent preservation.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No permanent future supplier stack is inferred from the 2020 partnership or today’s public pages.

longform.closing: Paris Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
